column22: Vimeo strives to provide accurate and comprehensive data in this transparency report. However, due to the complexities of our content moderation process, some data limitations may exist. Content removal or restriction actions may generate multiple event records, particularly during account termination workflows. Additionally, resolving multiple complaints against a single account with a single moderation action may inflate or distort certain figures. While we endeavor to report activity at the highest level impacting the account, some record duplication may occur. Vimeo is committed to ongoing system enhancements to improve the accuracy and availability of data in our transparency reporting.
